name: Genny by LOVO
summary: Genny by LOVO offers AI voiceovers and text-to-video creation for marketing, e-learning, and creative projects, with dozens of voices and languages.
description:
Genny by LOVO offers AI voiceovers and text-to-video creation for marketing, e-learning, and creative projects, with dozens of voices and languages.

AI voice generator: Access over 500 realistic voices in more than 100 languages and accents for any project. Text-to-video: Transform scripts into video presentations with synchronized visuals and narration. Voice cloning: Replicate your own or an actor’s voice for highly customized voiceovers. Audio editing suite: Edit, mix, and enhance voice tracks to achieve perfect results in every video.

pricing.label: Freemium

howToUse.title: Create a Genny Account
howToUse.description: Go to the Genny by LOVO site and sign up for a free or paid account. Log in to access your dashboard.

howToUse.title: Start a New Project
howToUse.description: Create a new project: choose between text-to-video or voiceover-only workflow based on your needs.

howToUse.title: Input or Upload Script
howToUse.description: Type your script or upload a document. For video creation, Genny will sync text with visuals and narration.

howToUse.title: Select a Voice and Language
howToUse.description: Choose from 500+ AI voices in 100+ languages and accents. Use voice cloning if you want to replicate a specific voice.

howToUse.title: Customize Visuals (Text-to-Video)
howToUse.description: For video projects, add images, slides, or backgrounds. Arrange audio and visuals on the timeline.

howToUse.title: Edit and Mix Audio
howToUse.description: Fine-tune timing, pitch, and effects for narration. Edit background music or sound effects in the audio suite.

howToUse.title: Preview and Export
howToUse.description: Preview your voiceover or video, make final adjustments, and export the finished file in your desired format.
